qa_pair.question: Use only the frozen-evaluation-v1 fixture. After reading the current state, page through the deck with limit 3. How many copies including upgrades share the ID of the first attack in the hand? Answer an integer.
In frozen-evaluation-v1, identify the card at the center of the complete hand, then find its matching UUID in the paginated deck. Return that card's Korean name only.
In frozen-evaluation-v1, compare the current hand's first card with every deck copy of its ID. What is the largest displayed damage among those copies? Answer an integer.

In frozen-evaluation-v1, inspect the current state and the public piles context. Can their evidence establish the exact next draw despite the draw pile containing an upgraded card? Answer True or False.
In frozen-evaluation-v1, match deck UUIDs to discard-pile UUIDs. How many discarded cards are skills, excluding curses? Answer an integer.
In frozen-evaluation-v1, inspect the current state and full public map, paging with limit 2. How many nodes marked R are above the lowest map row? Answer an integer.
In frozen-evaluation-v1, compare current narration with its on-demand history. What is the earliest no-longer-displayed utterance? Return its exact Korean text only.
In frozen-evaluation-v1, locate the hand's center card, then retrieve its full deck entry by UUID. Return the keyword title that explains its positional effect.
In frozen-evaluation-v1, inspect the current state and request fixture-choice without issuing an action. Is there an applied receipt whose state precedes the current state? Answer True or False.
In frozen-evaluation-v1, compare every card in the paginated deck with all three on-demand off-hand piles. How many deck UUIDs remain outside those piles? Answer an integer.
